ZPU_FV_AP.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  A.MONTH,
  A.YEAR, -- Natively drives the chronological hierarchy breakdown row-by-row
  A.CALMONTH,
  A.QUARTER,
  A.CALWEEK,
  A.DATE_SAP,
  A.DAY_OF_WEEK,
  A.DAY_INT,
 
  B.CompanyCode,
  B.CompanyCodeText,
  B.Supplier,              -- Native Supplier ID field from ACDOCA_VIEW
  B.CompanyCodeCurrency,
  B.FiscalYear,
  B.GLAccount,
  B.ChartOfAccounts,
  B.ControllingArea,
  B.FunctionalArea,
  B.BusinessArea,
  B.GLAccountType,
  B.ProfitCenter,
  B.CostCenter,
  B.FiscalPeriod,
  B.PostingDate,
  B.Supplier,
 
  B.AncestorLevel1Value,
  B.AncestorLevel2Value,
  B.AncestorLevel3Value,
  B.AncestorLevel4Value,
  B.AncestorLevel5Value,
 
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Local Currency (HSL) Totals
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  SUM(B.AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency) AS CO_CODE_CURRENCY_TOTAL,
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
    THEN B.AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS CURRENT_YEAR_LOCAL,
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
    THEN B.AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_LOCAL,

  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  -- Global Currency (KSL) Totals
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  SUM(B.AmountInGlobalCurrency) AS GLOBAL_CURRENCY_TOTAL,
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
    THEN B.AmountInGlobalCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS CURRENT_YEAR_GLOBAL,
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
    THEN B.AmountInGlobalCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_GLOBAL

FROM (
  SELECT
    BASE.rbukrs                         AS CompanyCode,
    COALESCE(CC.butxt, BASE.rbukrs)     AS CompanyCodeText,
    BASE.lifnr                          AS Supplier,
    BASE.rhcur                          AS CompanyCodeCurrency,
    BASE.gjahr                          AS FiscalYear,
    BASE.racct                          AS GLAccount,
    BASE.ktopl                          AS ChartOfAccounts,
    BASE.kokrs                          AS ControllingArea,
    BASE.rfarea                         AS FunctionalArea,
    BASE.rbusa                          AS BusinessArea,
    BASE.glaccount_type                 AS GLAccountType,
    BASE.prctr                          AS ProfitCenter,
    BASE.rcntr                          AS CostCenter,
    CAST(BASE.budat AS DATE)            AS PostingDate,
    CASE
      WHEN BASE.poper = '000' THEN '001'
      WHEN BASE.poper >= '013' THEN '012'
      ELSE BASE.poper
    END                                 AS FiscalPeriod,

    BASE.hsl                            AS AmountInCompanyCodeCurrency, -- Local currency
    BASE.ksl                            AS AmountInGlobalCurrency,      -- Global currency

    H.AncestorLevel1Value               AS AncestorLevel1Value,
    H.AncestorLevel2Value               AS AncestorLevel2Value,
    H.AncestorLevel3Value               AS AncestorLevel3Value,
    H.AncestorLevel4Value               AS AncestorLevel4Value,
    H.AncestorLevel5Value               AS AncestorLevel5Value

  FROM "ACDOCA_VIEW" AS BASE
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "RAD_S3P.ZI_T001" AS CC
    ON BASE.rbukrs = CC.bukrs
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "RAD_S3P.ZI_GLACCT_FLAT_BASE" AS H
    ON BASE.racct = H.GLAccount
  WHERE BASE.gjahr IN (
    :P_YEAR,
    CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - 1 AS NVARCHAR)
  )
  GROUP BY
    BASE.rbukrs,
    COALESCE(CC.butxt, BASE.rbukrs),
    BASE.lifnr,
    BASE.rhcur,
    BASE.gjahr,
    BASE.racct,
    BASE.ktopl,
    BASE.kokrs,
    BASE.rfarea,
    BASE.rbusa,
    BASE.glaccount_type,
    BASE.prctr,
    BASE.rcntr,
    BASE.budat,
    BASE.poper,
    BASE.hsl,
    BASE.ksl,
    H.AncestorLevel1Value,
    H.AncestorLevel2Value,
    H.AncestorLevel3Value,
    H.AncestorLevel4Value,
    H.AncestorLevel5Value
) AS B
 
LEFT OUTER JOIN "S4ONPREM.SAP.TIME.VIEW_DIMENSION_DAY" AS A
  ON A.DATE_SAP = B.PostingDate

WHERE A.YEAR IN (
  :P_YEAR,
  CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - 1 AS NVARCHAR)
)

GROUP BY
  A.MONTH, A.YEAR, A.CALMONTH, A.QUARTER, A.CALWEEK,
  A.DATE_SAP, A.DAY_OF_WEEK, A.DAY_INT,
  B.CompanyCode, B.CompanyCodeText, B.Supplier, B.CompanyCodeCurrency, B.FiscalYear, B.GLAccount,
  B.ChartOfAccounts, B.ControllingArea, B.FunctionalArea, B.BusinessArea,
  B.GLAccountType, B.ProfitCenter, B.CostCenter,
  B.PostingDate, B.FiscalPeriod,
  B.AncestorLevel1Value, B.AncestorLevel2Value, B.AncestorLevel3Value,
  B.AncestorLevel4Value, B.AncestorLevel5Value;
